states: Follow-up receipt for merging the repaired #2695 head (32fad38aa4, which contains current main) into this branch: the hook's final content is that head's hook minus the circuit-breaker supporting read this branch removes.

Embedded production builds (vite build into internal/api/frontend-modern/dist, go build) of 32fad38aa4 and of this merged tree (1b01ab6e1b), run on pulse-dev because local memory pressure refused heavy work; each on a private DEMO_MODE mock stack with a fresh data dir; the same Playwright script ran against both at both widths.

Patrol load, tab hide/show, stale-data banner forced by failing GET /api/settings/ai and Retry: GET /api/ai/circuit/status drops from one request per phase on the parent build to none; the banner shows and Retry clears it on both builds; no console errors on either.
Served active finding, Activity > Finding options and history, Resolve or dismiss > Open in Assistant: the Pulse Assistant drawer opens with the finding attached on both builds.
Patrol status forced to runtime_state blocked with blocked_cause circuit_open (page.route): both builds show 'Patrol paused' with 'circuit breaker is open'.

Across the run the only other endpoint difference is one GET /api/updates/plan from the update banner, which fires once the server's background update check completes and does not depend on this change.

Dist proof on pulse-dev: 187 files each side; after normalising chunk hashes, SRI strings and short identifiers, only the removed store loader, signal, getter and API client differ in index.js and the removed supporting read in AIIntelligence.js.
interactions: Demo auto sign-in; on /patrol open the Activity tab and 'Finding options and history', expand the served finding, open 'Resolve or dismiss', click 'Open in Assistant', close the drawer.

Dispatch visibilitychange hidden then visible; reload with GET /api/settings/ai failing, wait for the banner, restore the route and click Retry, wait for the banner to clear; reload /patrol with a circuit_open Patrol status.
Desktop 1440x900 and phone 390x844 contexts; screenshots of the Patrol page, Finding options and history, the Assistant drawer, the stale-data banner and the paused banner inspected.
